palette._source: wetzels.com /assets/css/style.css (#004089 x48, #FED900 x15, #B7E5F0) and nav/logo.svg (#003783). primary_deep, sky_soft and ink are Platterly additions for shadows, washes and text.
palette._usage: Blue bands with the white wordmark; yellow for buttons, prize cards and highlights; sky blue for notes.

fonts._note: Londrina Solid is the display face on wetzels.com (Google Fonts). The site body uses Roboto/Gotham/Montserrat via Typekit; Montserrat is the Google Fonts match.

logo.source: https://wetzelspretzels.ca/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/wetzel-logo.png (white version made from its alpha channel)

voice.tone: playful, warm, snack-first; short fun headlines, then one plain sentence
taglines_seen: The best things in life are fresh.
do: name real menu items (Original, Sinful Cinnamon, Cin-A-Bitz, Wetzel Dog)
say 'Taxes extra' next to any price
dont: quote delivery-app prices as walk-in prices
promise catering until the store confirms it
imply this is a Wetzel's head-office promotion

compliance.contest: No purchase necessary. One spin per person per day. Odds and full rules in the game. Draw winners answer a skill-testing question. (Competition Act s.74.06)
compliance.casl: Marketing consent is a separate, unticked box naming Wetzel's Pretzels Toronto Eaton Centre, 220 Yonge St, 647-250-8200. Replace with the legal operator name once known.
compliance.franchise: Franchisor (MTY / Wetzel's Canada) and mall (Cadillac Fairview) sign-off needed for branded contests, codes and screens.
